lead.title: Nvidia's Kyber rack for Rubin Ultra delayed to 2028, creating rare opening for rivals
lead.summary: CNBC and Tom's Hardware confirm manufacturing challenges with Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 rack for Rubin Ultra GPUs have pushed the flagship scale-up system more than 12 months behind schedule. Hyperscaler customers rejected a stopgap NVL72x2 design, leaving Nvidia without a proven solution for Rubin Ultra in 2027 and handing AMD and Google's custom chips a potential opening at the high end of the AI market.

top_stories.title: Anthropic reveals Claude's internal 'global workspace' — J-Space interpretability breakthrough
top_stories.summary: Anthropic researchers identified a privileged subspace (J-Space) in Claude's activations that functions like a global workspace for conscious access. Claude can perform silent reasoning steps there, and hidden goals become visible. An interactive demo is available on Neuronpedia.

top_stories.title: Tencent open-sources Hy3: 295B MoE model under Apache 2.0 with 256K context
top_stories.summary: Hy3 is a 295B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model activating only 21B parameters per token with a 256K context window. Released under Apache 2.0, it matches or beats flagship closed models on agentic and coding tasks. Available free on Nous Portal and OpenRouter for a limited time with day-0 SGLang support including FP8 checkpoint and speculative decoding.

top_stories.title: Even Realities hits unicorn status with $150M round for AI smart glasses
top_stories.summary: The Shenzhen-based startup founded by a former Apple engineer raised $150M in a pre-Series B round led by Meituan and Tencent, reaching a $1B valuation. The company develops AI-powered smart glasses in the rapidly growing AI wearable hardware sector.

top_stories.title: Are humanoid robots ready to be deployed? The New Yorker examines the state of the field
top_stories.summary: A feature article surveys a dozen humanoid models — including 1X Technologies' Neo, Figure 03, Boston Dynamics' Atlas, and Tesla Optimus — as they prepare to hit the market. Experts warn physical AI lacks a 'ChatGPT moment,' and safety around children and pets remains unresolved. The Neo lists at $20,000 with over 10,000 deposits.

items.title: ByteDance releases Seed2.0 model series targeting real-world complexity
items.summary: Seed2.0 delivers world-leading reasoning, visual understanding, and search capabilities grounded in a user-need-based evaluation framework focused on long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following.

items.title: Embodied.cpp: Portable inference runtime for VLA models on heterogeneous robots
items.summary: A portable C++ inference runtime achieves 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates on HY-VLA and pi0.5 benchmarks respectively, while reducing WAM benchmark block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB.

items.title: OrbitQuant: Data-agnostic quantization for image and video diffusion transformers
items.summary: Using permuted block-Hadamard rotation and Lloyd-Max codebooks, OrbitQuant sets SOTA for post-training quantization on FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX, reaching W2A4 with usable generation quality.

items.title: VLA-Corrector: Adaptive detection and correction for robotic manipulation policies
items.summary: A corrective inference framework for action-chunked VLA policies detects visual dynamics deviations via a latent-space vision monitor and triggers corrective replanning without retraining the backbone.

items.title: Measuring the gap between human and LLM research ideas at scale
items.summary: A two-axis research-taste taxonomy finds LLM-generated research ideas cluster around bridge-like opportunities and synthesis methods, diverging systematically from the broader distribution of human research papers.

items.title: Tencent open-sources Hy3: 295B MoE under Apache 2.0
items.summary: The 295B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model activating 21B parameters per token with 256K context is released under Apache 2.0, matching closed models on agentic and coding tasks. Available on Nous Portal and OpenRouter with day-0 SGLang support.

items.title: DSpark speculative debugging now in SGLang for DeepSeek-V4 and Qwen3
items.summary: LMSYS announced production support for DeepSeek's DSpark speculative decoding framework in SGLang, improving throughput by 60-85% over MTP-1 baselines. Supports DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and Qwen3 models with open-sourced kernels.

items.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B cuts thinking tokens by ~50% while maintaining accuracy
items.summary: BottleCap AI's fine-tune of Qwen3.6-27B reduces reasoning tokens by an average of 50% (up to 90% in best cases) while maintaining original accuracy. Released under Apache 2.0 and built via online RL on holdout portions of target datasets.

items.title: Nvidia reaffirms AI chip roadmap, rejects Kyber delay reports
items.summary: Nvidia pushed back against the SemiAnalysis report claiming manufacturing delays, stating its AI chip roadmap remains intact and production plans for next-generation AI accelerators are on track. Shares stabilized in after-hours trading.

items.title: AMD Ryzen AI Halo Dev Kit review: AI development in a mini-PC
items.summary: LTT Labs reviews AMD's mini-PC built around the Zen 5 Ryzen AI Max+ 395 with 128 GB unified LPDDR5x-8000 memory. Priced at $3,999 with ROCm support, it targets AI developers running local LLMs and rivals the Mac Studio.

items.title: Glaze by Raycast: Build native Mac apps by chatting with AI
items.summary: Raycast's Glaze lets users create native macOS applications through natural language, connecting to APIs, local CLIs, and MCPs. Published apps can be shared in a store.

items.title: Pulpie: Pareto-optimal models for web content extraction, 20x cheaper
items.summary: Feyn's family of models matches SOTA extraction quality while being 20x cheaper — cleaning 1 billion pages costs $7,900 with Pulpie vs $159,000 with alternatives. Open-source on Hugging Face.

items.title: OfficeCLI: Open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents
items.summary: A single-binary open-source Office suite that lets AI agents read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without requiring an Office installation.

items.title: Bespoke Labs raises $40M Series A for AI agent training environments
items.summary: The round was led by Wing VC with Mayfield, The House Fund, and 8VC. Bespoke builds reinforcement learning environments to train reliable AI agents for production use.

items.title: Sherpa.ai raises $18M for data-sovereign AI platform
items.summary: Growth round led by Forgepoint Capital brings federated learning and privacy-preserving AI to regulated enterprises and governments.

items.title: Katalyze AI raises $10.5M seed for agentic AI in pharma manufacturing
items.summary: Led by Bonfire Ventures, the seed round funds an agentic operating system for pharmaceutical manufacturing with five top-20 pharma customers already on board.
